note: Clay's beetle rig (models/beetle-rig-oct30/char.glb) with Spring's 8 clips baked in; mesh and bones unchanged, uncompressed (meshopt-pack it like other models). Clips play directly on this model (no retarget). rootSpeed is in model units per second: multiply by the game scale of the model. Floor contact already fixed per frame.
